findings.title: Invalid ERB syntax `<%- end if %>` will break rendering
findings.body: The `if` block is closed as `end if` with no condition, which is not valid ERB/Ruby and will fail the embed page. This template is the success path for `/embed/best`; requests for an existing topic will error instead of rendering comments.

findings.title: Imported raw HTML is rendered unescaped
findings.body: `post.cooked` is emitted with `raw`. Imported posts are created with `cook_method: Post.cook_methods[:raw_html]`, and `Post#cook` now returns `raw` directly for that method, bypassing Discourse's normal cooking/sanitization. RSS or readability content can therefore contain executable `<script>`/event-handler markup that runs in the Discourse origin for every visitor of the embedded comments.

findings.title: URL is interpolated into HTML without escaping
findings.body: The imported-from footer builds `#{url}` with the raw URL. A URL such as `http://example.com/'>` passes the `https?://` regex and breaks out of the attribute before being stored as raw HTML. This is an independent HTML/script injection vector and should be HTML-escaped or constructed with a safe helper.

findings.title: PollFeed assumes every feed item has `content`
findings.body: `i.content.scrub` raises `NoMethodError` when an RSS item uses the common `<description>` element or has no content instead of `content:encoded`. The importer should fall back to `i.content || i.description` and skip entries where both are blank.

findings.title: fetch_http calls `.downcase` without checking `embed_by_username`
findings.body: `SiteSetting.embed_by_username.downcase` can fail with `NoMethodError` when the setting is nil/unset, which the controller and RetrieveTopic do not prevent. PollFeed guards this setting with `present?` before polling, but `TopicRetriever#fetch_http` does not. Add a blank check and return early before querying.

findings.title: Remote reads have no timeout
findings.body: `open(url).read` uses default open/read timeouts, so a slow or stalled source can block a Sidekiq worker indefinitely. PollFeed has the same issue at `app/jobs/scheduled/poll_feed.rb:29`. Use explicit `open_timeout` and `read_timeout` values or another HTTP client with timeout support.

findings.title: Throttle key expiry is not atomic with creation
findings.body: `setnx` followed by `expire` has a crash window between the two calls that can leave the `retrieved:<url>` key with no TTL. That URL would then be throttled forever. Use an atomic NX+EX set (or a Lua script/MULTI) so the key is always created with an expiry.

findings.title: Disqus import loses original thread creation time
findings.body: The previous importer passed `created_at: Date.parse(t[:created_at])` when creating the initial topic. The new `TopicEmbed.import_remote` path does not accept or set `created_at`, so imported topics are stamped with the current time while replies still use their original timestamps, breaking chronological ordering.
